svg.aria-label: Agent runs are labeled by their tests, then by a second check on hidden inputs. Runs that pass both become fine-tuning rows and chosen preference samples; runs that fail the second check move to the rejected side. Four gamed runs pass the tests; without the second check, 4 of 10 fine-tuning rows are gamed.
